content.comment_body: Hello, Software: [product_name] [version_no] Controller: [product_name] [version_no] Regarding the attached image, when trying to go online or redownload the program, a password prompt appears. The password set previously was INT123, but now the dialog prevents entry when numbers are typed in the password field. Please assist with this issue. Thank you in advance.

From my experience, assigning a password like "INT123" for the program appears to be impossible. When creating a password and entering numbers, the software shows a message indicating only letters from A to Z are valid. I've tested this with several [product_name] software versions: [version_no], [version_no], [version_no], [version_no], [version_no], and [version_no].
Hello, The password was set at first, but when I attempt to download or test the program online, the pop-up prevents me from entering the same password.
As mentioned earlier: It's not possible to create passwords containing numbers. Only alphabetic characters are accepted.

analysis.insight_summary: Users reported issues with password rules in [product_name] software, specifically an unexpected restriction so that only alphabetic passwords are accepted. Attempts to set or use passwords with numbers resulted in error messages, leading to confusion about password requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated the ability to set and enter program passwords containing both letters and numbers for authentication in [product_name] software.
